svg.aria-label: BlackLothus — Computer Engineering student. I develop software architectures and build embedded IoT systems. A visual-effects shot breakdown: a city with one tower per day of the last year, as tall as that day was busy, rendered as wireframe, clay, normals and depth passes, then the final beauty pass at sunset, with the name as the title.
